General.Title: General
General.LanguageHint: Restart the app to apply the language change.
General.ResetWarning: Resetting deletes ALL your configuration (desktops, spaces, pins, protections, apps, shortcuts, widgets and usage) and CANNOT be undone. The app restarts with default values.
Config.ManagedDesktopsHint: The order defines the desktop index. The app creates missing ones (Win+Ctrl+D) and renames the first N with these names. Renaming does NOT move windows.
Config.DesktopsNoneMissing: Done. None were missing (only mismatched names were renamed).
Config.AppsHint: VS Code, Warp, WSL, Claude/OpenCode CLI are auto-detected if installed. Add your own here. In Arguments, use {path} where the folder goes (if omitted, the folder is passed as an argument).
Config.AppRequiredFields: Fill in at least Name and Path to executable.
Config.ProtectionsHint: A protected desktop only admits apps in its list; any other that appears there is sent to MAIN. Only desktops that are NOT MAIN or DESK+ (those are space desktops) can be protected. Changes are saved instantly and applied when entering the desktop.
Config.ProtHint: Protect the desktop to manage its list of allowed apps.
Config.PinsHint: A pinned app moves and maximizes to its desktop whenever it appears on another. Pinning is by desktop NAME, so reordering them does not break it. Changes are saved instantly.
Config.PinManualTooltip: Process name, e.g.: brave.exe — pinned to the desktop selected above
Config.TaskAccountsHint: Connect one or more task managers at once (Vikunja, JIRA, Trello). The picker (Win+NumLock) merges all enabled accounts and shows which account each task came from. Add one per client.
Config.AccountNameTooltip: E.g.: 'Trello — Coca Client'. What you see in the picker.
Config.VikunjaUserTooltip: Your Vikunja username — required to filter only your tasks
Config.TokenStorageWarning: The token is stored in plain text in %APPDATA%\AmpzDesktopBooster\tasks.json. Do not share it.
Config.JiraNotReady: The JIRA adapter does not fetch yet — you can save credentials, but 'Test connection' will report it is coming soon.
Config.TrelloApiKeyTooltip: Create a Power-Up at https://trello.com/power-ups/admin → 'API key' field
Config.TrelloTokenTooltip: Generate the token from the 'Token' link next to your API key
Config.TrelloIgnoredLists: Lists to ignore (extras — one per line or comma-separated)
Config.TrelloIgnoredListsTooltip: E.g.: Done, Validated, In review. Matched by 'contains' case-insensitive. ADDED to defaults (done, cancelled, terminado, etc.)
Config.TrelloStorageWarning: Fetches your assigned cards from all boards. Automatically filters cards marked complete AND those in terminal lists (done/cancelled + the ones you add here). Key and token stored in plain text in %APPDATA%\AmpzDesktopBooster\tasks.json — do not share them.
Config.TaskNoCredentials: This account has no credentials for the selected type.
Config.AttentionHint: Alerts when a desktop requests your attention (Claude and future integrators). The app plays the sound: choose a .wav per level and test it. Changes are saved when you press Save.
Config.SameDeskGate: When the alert is from my current desktop:
Config.SameDeskGateHint: You're already there: you may want only sound (no toast), only toast, both, or nothing.
Config.BrowserHint: When you click a link, Windows opens it in the browser window on ANOTHER desktop and sends you there. With this enabled, the app intercepts and opens the link in a NEW window on YOUR current desktop — without moving you.
Config.BrowserEnabled: Open links on the current desktop (browser shim)
Config.RealBrowser: Real browser (where we forward the links)
Config.RealBrowserHint: Empty = auto-detects Brave. You can set another browser manually (e.g. chrome.exe / msedge.exe with full path).
Config.BrowserSetupHint: Windows does NOT allow an app to set itself as the default browser (it's a security measure). You need to manually choose 'Ampz Desktop Booster' in Settings → Default apps, for http and https. One click, once.
Config.BrowserIsDefault: ✓ Ampz is your default browser. Links open on your current desktop.
Config.BrowserRegisteredNotDefault: Registered as a candidate, but NOT yet the default. Choose 'Ampz Desktop Booster' in Default Apps (button below).
Config.BrowserDisabled: Disabled. Enable the checkbox and save to register as a browser.
Config.BrowserSavePrompt: Done. Now choose 'Ampz Desktop Booster' as browser for http and https in Settings → Default Apps (open it with the button below).
Config.ScopesHint: A SPACE is a working scope (a client, your company, personal work). A CONTEXT is a part of that space, with its own color, variables and notes. Reorganize them here: rename, recolor, move a context to another space, promote it to its own space, or demote a space into a context. Changes are saved instantly and carry variables, notes and defaults along.
Config.ScopesEmpty: No spaces yet. Create the first one with Win + NumpadEnter on a DESK +N desktop.
Config.ScopesDupPorts:
The duplicated commands came out on a different port: {0}.

A port has ONE owner across the whole catalog, so a copy cannot keep the original's — there would be two owners of the same number and the 🟢 state would lie on both rows. They got the first free one: check them if your command pins the port somewhere else.
Config.ScopesDupInherit:
"{0}" was created in "{1}".

Mind the INHERITANCE: the copy now sees the variables and commands of "{1}", not those of "{2}". What the original context inherited from its space did NOT travel — its own stuff did.
Config.ScopesDeleteSpaceConfirm:
Delete the space '{0}'?

ALL of its contexts will be removed too, with their variables and notes.
This cannot be undone.
Config.ScopesDeleteContextConfirm:
Delete the context '{0}'?

Its variables and notes will be removed too.
Desktops using it will fall back to the space, with no context.
Config.ScopesMoveConfirm:
Move the context '{0}' to the space '{1}'?

Its own variables and notes come along. NOTE: whatever it INHERITED from '{2}' is lost — it now inherits from '{1}'.
Config.ScopesPromoteConfirm:
Promote '{0}' to its own space?

Its variables and notes come along, and it stops inheriting from '{1}'.
It loses its color: colors identify contexts within a space.
Config.ScopesDemoteConfirm:
Demote the space '{0}' into a context of '{1}'?

Its variables and notes come along, and it starts inheriting from '{1}'.
Config.ScopeErrNameTaken: Something named '{0}' already exists at that same level. Pick another name.
Config.ScopeErrWouldNest:
'{0}' cannot be demoted because it HAS its own contexts, and there is no third level.

Move or promote them first, then try again.
Config.ScopeErrNotFound: That space or context no longer exists. Refresh the list.
Config.ScopeErrSameTarget: Source and target are the same.
Config.ScopeErrDuplicatePath:
'{0}' already has a variable with that same path.

Nothing was moved: delete the duplicate in the target first.
Config.CmdsHint: The commands that bring up each scope's basics. This is where they get REORGANIZED, three ways: Ctrl+C (or Ctrl+X to move) on your selection, click the target scope and Ctrl+V; or drag them onto the scope they belong to (hold Ctrl to copy); or use the target below. Pick several with Ctrl and Shift. Only each scope's OWN commands are listed, not inherited ones. ⏩ = joins "launch all" · ⚠ = the directory no longer exists · ⛔ = the port is duplicated in the catalog. To launch them and see what's up, Win+Numpad +.
Config.CmdsEmpty: This scope has no commands of its own. Add one with "New", or drag over the ones you already have in another scope.
Config.CmdsCopyPortReassigned:
The copy came out on a different port: {0}.

A port has ONE owner across the whole catalog, so copying a command can't carry the original's port — there'd be two owners of the same number. It got the first free one: check it and adjust if your command pins the port elsewhere.
Config.VarsHint: The variables (paths and URLs) you open with Win + Numpad *. Here you edit them and MOVE them between scopes: pick several with Ctrl or Shift and use Ctrl+C (or Ctrl+X to move) → click the target scope → Ctrl+V; or drag a row from the right and drop it on a space or context on the left (hold Ctrl to copy instead of move). Mind the inheritance: what lives in the SPACE is seen by all its contexts; what lives in GLOBAL is seen everywhere. Each list shows only what the scope OWNS.
Config.VarsEmpty:
This scope owns no variables.
Create one with ✚ New, or drag one in from another scope.
Config.VarsNoMatch: No variable in this scope matches the filter.
Config.VarsDeleteOneConfirm:
Delete the variable '{0}'?

This cannot be undone.
Config.VarsDeleteManyConfirm:
Delete {0} variables?

This cannot be undone.
Vars.FldTitle: Title (how you see it in the list)
Vars.DlgHint: With no title, the path is used. A path can be a folder, a file or a URL — it opens with the same criteria as the Win + Numpad * shortcut.
Vars.StatusUrl: It's a URL: opens in the browser.
Vars.StatusMissing: Not found on disk (saved anyway: it may be a disconnected drive or something you haven't cloned yet).
Config.ClipCopy: ⧉ {0} copied from "{1}" — Ctrl+V to paste here
Config.ClipCut: ✂ {0} cut from "{1}" — Ctrl+V to paste here
Config.ClipStale:
What you had on the clipboard no longer matches its source scope: something was edited, deleted or moved since you copied it.

Nothing was pasted — pasting the wrong entry would be worse. Go back to the source scope and copy again.
Config.ResetAllConfirm:
This deletes ALL settings and CANNOT be undone:

• Managed desktops
• Spaces and contexts (history, paths, notes)
• Pins
• Protections and whitelists
• "Open with" apps and their shortcuts
• Bar widgets and usage panel

The app will restart with default settings.

Services.Hints: Enter: launch (or visit if it has no command) · Shift+Enter: visit in browser · Ctrl+Enter: launch everything that's down · ⏩ = joins "launch all" · F2: edit · Del: delete · Ctrl+C: copy localhost · Ctrl+Shift+C: copy with network IP · Esc: close
Services.DlgHint: The port is OPTIONAL and defines what this is: WITH a port it's a server (it gets the 🟢/⚪ status and joins "launch all"); WITHOUT one it's a one-off task (npm ci, migrate) that only fires manually.
Services.TokensHint: Shortcuts resolved at launch time: {ip} = your CURRENT network IP · {port} = the port below. E.g. npm run dev -- --port {port} --strictPort --host {ip}
Services.PreviewNoIp: ⚠ No network IP right now: {ip} will stay unresolved at launch.
Services.PreviewNoPort: ⚠ You're using {port} but no port is set below.
Services.ErrTokenNoIp: The command uses {ip} but there's no network IP available (are you off the LAN?). Connect, or drop the token from the command.
Services.ErrTokenNoPort: The command uses {port} but this service declares no port. Edit it and set the port — that way the command and the 🟢/⚪ status come from the SAME number.
Services.FldPort: Port (empty = listens on none; only affects the 🟢/⚪ status):
Services.AutoStartOff: ⏸ Won't start on its own: manual only, with Enter.
Services.AutoStartAutoOn: ⏩ Automatic: since it declares a port it counts as a server and WILL start. Check or uncheck to decide yourself.
Services.AutoStartAutoOff: ⏸ Automatic: with no port it counts as a one-off task and won't start. Check it if it's a worker (queue:work, watcher) that does need to come up.
Services.NeedsPort: This service declares no port, so there's no URL to visit. Edit it and set the port it listens on.
Services.InvalidPort: Invalid port. Leave it empty, or use a number between 1 and 65535.
Services.PortTaken:
Port {0} is already taken by "{1}" ({2}).

A port has ONE owner across the whole catalog: if two services declare the same one, whichever starts second won't come up (or worse, serves you the first one's app), and the 🟢 status turns green on BOTH rows, because it watches the port, not the process.
Services.NeedSomething: Fill in at least a title, a command or a port — otherwise the row says nothing.
Services.ErrNoCommand: This service has no command: it's monitor-only (I can watch its port, but I don't know how to start it). Edit it and add the command.
Services.ErrNoWorkDir: Missing working directory: a command with nowhere to run can't be launched.
Services.NothingToLaunch: Nothing to launch: either everything is already listening, or no service in this scope declares both a port and a command.
Services.InheritedReadOnly: This service is INHERITED (from the parent space or the global pool) and can't be edited here: changing it would change it for every context that sees it. Go to the scope where it lives and edit it there.
Services.NoNetworkMsg: No network IP available (are you off the LAN?). Can't build the network URL.
Services.QrHint: Scan with your phone (same Wi-Fi) · any key or click closes
